I know this is a late response but hope it's still helpful. In 2013 the legislature usurped all municipal authority for regulating door-to-door sales by "video service providers" via I.C. 8-1-34-30 giving sole rulemaking authority to the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission (IURC). The IURC has done squat to set rules for telecom sales such as appropriate hours or create a block list, and thus you get the problem you have now, which is anything goes. You still have a right not be harassed, however.

You have a couple options but the easiest one is to make a complaint to the IURC at this page and follow through with the complaint process. While this is working (or not) document each subsequent solicitor getting the ID information, maybe taking a pic, of the badge which is required to be worn on the outside of any clothing by any sales agent.

If the IURC won't take care of it then go talk to a local judge via a common law complaint for trespass with your complaints, letters, and ID information. Name the carrier and the also the direct marketer as defendants. This sucks that you have to do this but keep escalating and you'll get someone's attention eventually. Good luck!
